sio2_melting_3_subtask_structure_retriev.description: Retrieve structure of SiO2 and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

sio2_melting_3_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure the appropriate Tersoff potential file for SiO2 for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

sio2_melting_3_subtask_melting.name: SiO2 NPT Melting - Level 3
